p_copy.about: Gryffin headlines Marquee New York in Chelsea on Saturday, December 19, a night presented by the club itself. DICE bills it as a DJ night with Gryffin as the only name on the listing, which makes it a headline set rather than a festival-style bill.
p_copy.expect: Marquee is a large Chelsea nightclub on 10th Avenue, and this is one of its December headliner nights. The listing does not describe a theme, a dress code or production. My take: this is for people who already know Gryffin and want to see one name for the whole night; check resale or the waiting list, because DICE showed it sold out when we read it on October 30.
p_copy.music: Confirmed by DICE: Gryffin, tagged as a DJ set. The listing names no support acts and gives no set times, so neither is confirmed.
p_copy.before_you_go: DICE lists the night from 11 PM on December 19 to 4 AM, and the club's terms say ticket holders must arrive before 12:30 AM. It is 21+, and the club accepts only original photo ID: a US driver's license, a New York non-driver ID, a US military ID, or a passport or visa from any country. There are no door sales, per DICE. Bag policy, coat check, re-entry and the nearest subway are not confirmed.

faq.q: Is the Gryffin show at Marquee sold out?
faq.a: DICE showed it sold out on October 30. The ticket button on this page goes to DICE, where resale or a waiting list may open.
Before 12:30 AM: the club's terms say ticket holders must arrive by then. The night is listed from 11 PM to 4 AM.
Not confirmed. Gryffin is the only artist on the DICE listing.
The club's own terms say tickets are non-refundable. DICE lists a 24-hour cooling-off window after purchase. Check both before you buy.
An original photo ID: a US driver's license, a New York non-driver ID, a US military ID, or a passport or visa from any country. The night is 21+.

refunds_by_seller.Marquee New York (event terms): All items are non-refundable under any circumstances.
refunds_by_seller.DICE: 24-hour cooling-off period after purchase, per the DICE listing.
